name: Berliner Trödelmarkt Straße des 17. Juni

venue.name: Straße des 17. Juni, at S-Bahnhof Tiergarten

facts: every Saturday and Sunday, all year
antiques, art and crafts; no household goods, textiles or new packaged goods
notes: Hours conflict on the organiser page: banner says "jeden Samstag und Sonntag 10:00–16:00", a lower section says summer 09–17 / winter 09–16 with no switch date; recorded the banner. Coordinates are an approximate midpoint between Charlottenburger Tor and S Tiergarten (the address 110–114 does not geocode). Organiser says nothing about Volkstrauertag/Totensonntag (Nov 15/22) or the Christmas weekends — kept them in. Entry fee not stated.

description.de: Seit 1978 jedes Wochenende auf der Straße des 17. Juni, direkt am S-Bahnhof Tiergarten. Antiquitäten, Kunst und Kunsthandwerk; Haushaltswaren, Textilien und Neuware sind nicht zugelassen. Vier Foodtrucks, barrierefrei. Am Marathon-Wochenende Ende September fällt der Markt aus.
description.en: Every Saturday and Sunday since 1978 along Straße des 17. Juni, right at S-Bahn Tiergarten. Antiques, art and crafts; household goods, textiles and new packaged goods are not allowed. Four food trucks, step-free access. The market skips the marathon weekend at the end of September.
